ownerRequest: Use Buffer results and ADA to build next topics

topics.topic: An exposed API key: why deleting the file is not the recovery
topics.hook: You deleted the leaked API key. Why can it still work?
topics.payoff: Demonstrate revoking a dummy scoped credential, replacing it, and testing that the old credential fails. Clearly label simulation if no safe test environment is available.
topics.cta: Check which exposed credentials still need revoking.
topics.distinctFromPrevious: Credential invalidation after exposure, rather than browser variable placement or workflow access.
requiredEvidence: Safe disposable test credential and redacted before/after response, or explicitly labeled diagram
topics.visualPlan: Redacted old credential ACCEPTED -> revoke -> DENIED, followed by a replacement-access flow; no credential text on screen.

topics.topic: Compare two AI assistants on the same refund-policy edge case
topics.hook: Both AIs sound right. Which one invented a refund?
topics.payoff: Use one synthetic refund policy and the exact same test cases. Show the policy violation before explaining a small scored comparison. No brand winner without recorded output.
topics.cta: Test one policy edge case before trusting the reply.
topics.distinctFromPrevious: New measured policy-adherence example, not a generic assistant comparison, prompt overview or website approval-file check.
requiredEvidence: Synthetic policy and fixed test prompts
Full saved outputs, model versions, rubric and manual scoring
Check full historical comparison article for overlap before approval
topics.visualPlan: Policy beside actual model response; highlight unsupported promise; bar chart of real scored cases with sample count.

topics.topic: Own the domain, not just the website login
topics.hook: You own the website. Who controls the domain?
topics.payoff: Explain registrar ownership, DNS and hosting as separate controls using a dummy redacted handover example.
topics.cta: Check who controls your domain renewal and recovery.
topics.distinctFromPrevious: Narrow registrar recovery/control demonstration, not another general handover checklist.
requiredEvidence: Compare the existing handover checklist before approval
topics.visualPlan: Domain -> DNS -> hosting dependency flow and a three-row access checklist.

topics.topic: An AI review reply can promise something your business never offered
topics.hook: Did your AI reply just promise a refund?
topics.payoff: Demonstrate an approval-held review reply constrained by a synthetic business policy.
topics.cta: Check promises before you approve an AI reply.
topics.distinctFromPrevious: Specific promise detection, not broad review-response automation; hold if topic B is selected so the same payoff is not repeated.
requiredEvidence: Saved unedited output and corrected draft
No real customer data or automatic reply publishing
topics.visualPlan: Claim -> policy check -> owner approval flow.

topics.topic: Your personal AI login should not be the business handover plan
topics.hook: If you leave, can the business still access its AI work?
topics.payoff: Map shared assets, approved SOP, account ownership and documented export/recovery options without recommending password sharing.
topics.cta: Record where the business can recover its AI work.
topics.distinctFromPrevious: Ownership and recovery of AI work, rather than choosing a first AI task or explaining what an SOP is.
requiredEvidence: Current official export and workspace ownership documentation for selected tool
